column10: Married Rebecca O’Hara, daughter of Laurence O’Hara
Of Lough Esk Sister Isabelle married William Sinclair
Of Raphoe, Rev. John Lamy, Prebendary of Killymard, 1746-50. MA, Headmaster of Raphoe in 1733 and again from 1761 to 1771., Vicar general of Raphoe, 1742, Rector of Aghanunshin 1756-1773
Brooke Hill, inherited from Basil Brooke
Hollyhill, Strabane, married Isabelle Young, sister of Thomas Young Jnr
Castelshanagan, Letterkenny, possibly his brother Alexander II 1733-1816

Ballyconnel, Falcarragh later of Ballyness, [Died] On the 12th inst. at Little Ballyconnel, County Donegal, Wybrants Olpherts, Esq., aged 96, most sincerely and deservedly regretted (Saunders News Letter)
MP for Lifford, High Sherriff in 1773
Mallin Hall ( Strinet - George Harvey of Malin Hall, Sheriff of Donegal (b 1713, d 1773)
Sir Henry Hamilton, bart. M. P. for the borough of Killybegs, sister Letitia married John Olphert
MP for Donegal 1761, of Prehen (estate in Rathmullen) Andrew Knox of Rathmullan and Munnymore (d before 13.12.1774, Colonel, MP) (Stirnet)
Kilcaddan HIgh Sheriff in 1776 married Elizabeth daughter of Charles Nesbitt
Of Edenmore, later Cavancor, married Francelina McClintock
LIkely married to Anne Babbington (related to Wrays)
